items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: she got on big Ann's (inaudible) behind

ctx.x: Well, she gave it to Ann in St. Louis, and she asked me did I get it, and I said, 'No, Dinah, I didn't get it.' She said, 'I'll find out why you didn't get it because I know who I gave it to to mail to you,' and she got on big Ann's (inaudible) behind. Excuse me.
